title: 2.2.18 Fix the Broken Chart
description: A flowchart arrives with five red checks and one actual mistake. Find the mistake, and learn to read the checker instead of guessing.
sourceRef: designed: defect-repair diagram practice (Appendix D), reinforcing decision-chart rules from 2.2.4/2.2.6
